presentation.summary: Scans what Sonarr and Radarr import, rename or delete, read from their history.
presentation.description_markdown: Autoscan source for Spark and Silo. It reads Sonarr and Radarr history and reports imported, renamed or deleted files for targeted scans. It needs no webhook, so it works even when the automation server cannot reach the media server.
presentation.setup_markdown: Open **Libraries → Autoscan**, enable Autoscan and choose **Add source → Sonarr & Radarr history**. Pick or add a Sonarr or Radarr connection (URL and API key). If Sonarr or Radarr sees your media under different paths than Spark or Silo, add a path rewrite on the source. Add one source per Sonarr or Radarr server.

capabilities.description: Reads imports, renames and deletions from a Sonarr or Radarr server's history.

scan_source.summary: Polls a Sonarr or Radarr server's history and scans the files it imported, renamed or deleted.
